Sidebar-structure reorder EMITS a proposal only (no runtime mutation, devModeReorderGuard); no new sidebar control or persisted variable. Earlier reorder: LayerPanel.tsx layer rows + SceneOverlayControls.tsx SceneOverlayRow gain data-dev-order-group/-id (groups 'layers:<section>' and 'scene-overlays') for UI-only sidebar reorder. Overlay reorder rebuilds the global environment.sceneOverlays registry key order (what the sidebar lists); no new sidebar control or persisted-control schema. No new sidebar control or persisted variable; reorder rearranges the editor catalog order only (scene/transition resolve by id). Earlier: phases 2-6 added an EditorRoot.tsx onDevCommit hook for the Save/Discard bar; dev-mode inspector controls remain outside the sidebar manifest; devTextOverrides is dev-authored state. Earlier still: SceneSectionPlanesContainer.tsx keeps representation-specific seismic section targets, SectionVisualsPanel exposes generic Section Visuals controls, and BoreholeLogsControls.tsx registers source-derived Utah FORGE borehole-log controls under FORGE Data > Bore Holes.
description: Canonical editor sidebar control manifest. Any user-facing editor sidebar control, command, section, or persisted variable must be represented here before editor-bar source changes are accepted.

devModeReorderGuard.note: Dev mode (key 'd') can reorder collections by direct manipulation. Data-backed collections (pages, page blocks, layers, overlays, page sections) reorder their own model and are allowed. Reordering manifest-governed sidebar STRUCTURE (bars, peer groups, subsections, control rows) changes the canonical control order/inventory and would diverge from this manifest. Before applying or persisting any dev-mode reorder of manifest-governed structure, the agent MUST check this manifest as the order source and CONFIRM with the operator; if it is a problem, the reorder must also rewrite the manifest entry order plus matching source and pass `npm run check:editor-controls`. See Editor-Control-Manifest-Policy.md > Dev-Mode Reorder Guard.
